<p class="eyebrow">About</p>

# Julien Tap

I am a microbial ecologist and metagenomics researcher at INRAE Micalis. My work sits at the intersection of human gut microbiome science, food microbial ecology and ecosystem engineering.
:::

::: {.bento}
::: {.tile .wide .dark}
### A translational ecology

My approach combines population cohorts, controlled ecosystems, multi-omics and modelling. I use each scale to challenge the others: observations generate hypotheses; experimental communities expose mechanisms; models reveal which interventions are plausible.
:::
::: {.tile .coral}
### Current focus

Microbiome trajectories, fermented-food communities, synthetic consortia and microbial digital twins.
:::
